narrative:
Shaker-Heights municipal court district has 48,347 registered voters, with 51.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 7.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 40.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 33.1 percentage points. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +20.2% D−R vs +39.0% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
